title: Hamming ball cardinality
statement:
Let $\alpha$ be a finite alphabet, and consider words of length $n$ over $\alpha$. For any centre word $u \in \alpha^n$ and any radius $r$, the Hamming ball $B_r(u)$ has cardinality equal to the ball volume at radius $r$ for a length-$n$ code over an alphabet of size $\abs{\alpha}$; that is,
\[
  \abs{B_r(u)} = \sum_{i=0}^{r} \binom{n}{i}\,(\abs{\alpha} - 1)^i.
\]
